column1: # diffusion-v1 (core/include/sieve/diffusion.hpp) on training-v1: shape, picture width, height, colours, levels,
# batch, learning rate, momentum, start seed; then each step's score (Q16 sum), predictions and the SHA-256 of
# the digits (a byte each), and a picture made from a noise picture with seed 77. The start: digits drawn from
# splitmix64 (the start seed), each mod 2^bits; the four training pictures: from splitmix64 seeded 1, each cell
# mod colours; training draws from splitmix64 seeded 3; the noise from splitmix64 seeded 11.
